title: Latent Heat Flow
description: Calculate latent heat flow due to moisture in air using English (Imperial) or SI (metric) units. The latent heat flow depends on the latent heat of vaporization, air density, air flow rate, and the difference in humidity ratio between two states.

rows: Latent heat of vaporization of water
components.content:
# Latent Heat Flow - SI and Imperial Units

## English (Imperial) Formula
**Ql = 60 × hwe × ρ × q × Δx**

Where:
- Ql = latent heat flow (Btu/hr)
- hwe = 1060 (Btu/lb) - latent heat of vaporization
- ρ = 0.075 (lb/ft³) - air density at standard conditions
- q = measured air flow (ft³/min)
- Δx = difference in humidity ratio (lbH₂O/lbdry_air)

## SI (Metric) Formula
**Ql = hwe × ρ × q × Δx / 3600**

Where:
- Ql = latent heat flow (kW)
- hwe = 2454 (kJ/kg) - latent heat of vaporization at 20°C
- ρ = 1.202 (kg/m³) - air density at standard conditions
- q = air flow (m³/hr)
- Δx = difference in humidity ratio (kgH₂O/kgdry_air)

outputs.label: Latent Heat Flow (Ql)
outputs.formula: inputs.unit_system === 'si' ? (inputs.hwe * inputs.rho * inputs.q * inputs.delta_x / 3600) : (60 * inputs.hwe * inputs.rho * inputs.q * inputs.delta_x)
